My AI agent had a rule that was supposed to keep it from waking me at night.

It never ran. Not once. For nine days it pushed to my phone at 9:37pm every night and I had no idea.

Here's how I caught it — and the system I built so it can't happen again. 🧵 pic.twitter.com/aS9A1Rsvhx

— Jeff Van Maanen (@VMVLAX) September 21, 2026
